walls.note: Koningsplein front, rectified whole (nieuw-engeland-crops.ts face-koningsplein-1, 40 px/m) plus the brief's w01-153 crop of the 1914 part and aimed views kp-se (2025-06-16) and x-...002361_pano_0007_000204 (2021-12-29). West to east: the 1914 extension of five axes between two raised end pavilions (0-11.6 m), a narrow 1914 bay with a two-storey oriel (11.6-15.8 m), then three 2.77 m bays of the 1899 building to the round corner.

items.where: 1899 bays, second floor: three round-arched windows with a cream archivolt and a low iron rail across the sill
items.how: cut openings with round heads (rise = half width), proud archivolt ring (archHead), green rail bar at the sill

items.where: 1899 bays, ground and first floor: sage-green iron window frames with a grid transom and whiplash arcs over the shop windows
items.how: green frames with grid bars in the transom band of every ground and first-floor opening; the whiplash curve as a green round-headed bar inside the ground-floor transom

items.where: 1899 piers between first and second floor and beside the arches: white art-nouveau cartouches
items.how: cream proud tablets with a smaller proud drop under them on each pier

items.where: frieze over the ground floor, 4.6-5.6 m

skip.note: tenant lettering (Victoria's Secret, Uniqlo) changes with the shop; the cream frieze band itself is modelled

items.where: 1899 part over the main cornice: slate mansard with round-headed dormers, one per bay
items.how: mansard swept along both fronts as an extruded section; dormer boxes with cream surrounds, round-headed glass and lead caps

items.where: 1914 part, spandrels between the second/third and third/fourth floors: carved square panels under every window
items.how: proud stone tablet with a recessed centre boss under each window

items.where: narrow 1914 bay at 11.6-15.8 m: three-sided oriel over two storeys on a console
items.how: three-sided stone oriel with glass on each face, console below and a slate cap

items.where: 1914 part: the two end axes rise as square pavilions over the parapet with a small attic window
items.how: front raised to 23.1 m over the end axes with an attic window; the middle parapet stays at 21.9 m with a dormer behind

items.where: 1914 mezzanine (5.9-8.6 m): low iron rails in each window
items.how: green rail bar inside the lower reveal

items.where: 1914 ground floor: dark green framed shop windows between grey stone piers
items.how: two wide glazed openings and a door with green frames, hardstone plinth

walls.note: The round corner (BAG radius 2.3 m) with its flank bays, and the tower over the main cornice; aimed views far-ne (b_20250109_1300_Track05_Sphere_00332, 2025-01-09, whole tower), x-...002936 (2023-01-16, portal), w02-50 thumb (2023-02-27).

items.where: corner of Koningsplein and Singel: the curved front of three storeys with three curved windows per storey
items.how: five flat facets on the BAG arc (window, pier, portal, pier, window) so each window stands in its own wall plane; bands and cornice turn with the facets

items.where: ground floor of the round corner: the deep round-arched corner entrance with a heavy stone surround
items.how: round-headed opening in the middle corner facet with a proud cream archivolt over a green-framed glazed door

items.where: over the corner: drum with arched windows, slate dome with lucarnes, open lantern with cast-iron balustrade, cupola and finial
items.how: octagonal drum with recessed round-headed windows (blind on the two faces the mansards abut) and a cornice ring, lathe dome, four lucarnes, open bronze lantern posts with a ring balustrade, cupola and finial

items.where: Koningsplein street name plate on the corner

walls.note: Singel front, rectified whole (face-singel-0/1, 40 px/m). From the corner: tower flank bay (0.6-3.3 m), the wide 1899 bay (3.8-10.3 m) with one great segmental arch over three lights, the narrow 1899 bay (10.9-13.6 m) carrying a raised pavilion to 24.5 m, the 1914 middle bay (14.1-18.6 m), the 1914 oriel bay (19.8-23.8 m), and Singel 466 (24.7-28.7 m), the early-18th-century neck-gabled house (Rijksmonument 5409) that BAG counts inside this pand.

items.where: wide 1899 bay, second floor: one segmental-arched window of three lights across 6 m
items.how: cut opening with a segmental head and two mullions, proud archivolt

items.where: narrow 1899 bay: raised square pavilion to 24.5 m with a window per storey
items.how: front raised over the bay with its own coping, windows at 3rd-5th storey

items.where: 1914 bay at 19.8-23.8 m: three-sided oriel over the first and second floors
items.how: three-sided stone oriel with glass faces, console and cap

items.where: Singel 466: dark brick front with white-framed sash windows and a neck gable with white scrolls and a cornice cap
items.how: brick front with white sash frames, neck gable outline as an extruded polygon, cream scroll pieces and cap

items.where: Singel 466 ground floor shop window with a white fascia
items.how: glazed shop opening with a white fascia band; tenant lettering not drawn

sources.name: Lijst van rijksmonumenten aan het Singel (Amsterdam, Zuid): Singel 466 (5409), Singel 468 / Koningsplein 2-6 (518360)
